name: Console
description: Log collector + viewer. Captures console.log/info/warn/error/debug + uncaught errors from the shell and every app iframe over a WebSocket. Backend stays running headless; opens a tab for the live log viewer on launch.

provides.name: logs
provides.description: Query the logs the Console collected from the shell and every app iframe: tail/search by level, source (appId) and text, a per-source overview, and wait for the next matching line.
